title: Q-TRAJ-neglected-loop-bindings: the bindings ledger had 15 rows, then none for 7 days: the loop that writes it has gone quiet
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** trajectory pass (TRAJECTORY-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation trajectory --probe neglected:loop:bindings
**Status:** open

the bindings ledger had 15 rows, then none for 7 days: the loop that writes it has gone quiet. Evidence: quiet_days 7.

Find why it went quiet while the system moved: a loop that no longer fires, an area nothing consumes. Fix the loop or retire the area with a recorded disposition.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation trajectory --probe neglected:loop:bindings` exits 0.
